page: Microsoft Azure HB120-64rs_v3 is a virtualized server instance belonging to the HBv3 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This server features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 CPU architecture with an Intel processor. It is equipped with 456.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory allocation of 7.12 GB per core.

For storage, the HB120-64rs_v3 includes 2412 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and supports Premium Storage. The instance is also RDMA (Remote Direct Memory Access) capable, facilitating high-throughput, low-latency networking interfaces. It does not include any GPU hardware accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the high memory-to-core ratio and integrated local NVMe SSD storage offer qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints and fast local scratch space without the overhead of external storage. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. Appropriate workloads for this configuration include memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, and high-performance computing tasks utilizing RDMA.
